name: San Bernardino Valley College Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take college classes at Valley College while you are in high school. You earn both high school and college credit.
who_can_apply: You must be in high school, in grades 9 to 12. You need a yes from your school, your parent or guardian, and the college.
pay_detail: Per-unit fees are waived. You may still pay small fees, like health or student service fees. Some school districts pay for books and some do not.
duration: By semester. Up to 11 units in fall or spring, or 15 with approval. Up to 7 units in summer.
deadline_text: Spring 2027 forms were due Oct 23, 2026. Spring classes start Jan 19, 2027. Later term dates are not posted as of Nov 2, 2026.
how_to_apply: Apply on OpenCCC and pick San Bernardino Valley College. Watch your email for your student ID. Send the Dual Enrollment Request Form with your parent's email. Your parent must sign within 7 days. Once it is approved, register in Self-Service.
notes: The college says late forms do not promise a seat. If you missed the date, you can still ask at (909) 384-4467 or sbvcdualenrollment@valleycollege.edu. Spring registration may open Nov 20, 2026, and the college says that date could change.
